answer: New identities join a cohort of seven strangers posting a shared $7,000 bond and standing together on one mesa. Earnings wait on a shared terrace until cleared: each month, auditors sample one cohort in ten and check work records, and members can dispute each other with evidence. If one fake is proven, the whole pool loses 10% and the cohort dissolves, so honest members guard their own bridge into the economy. Fielding 10,000 fakes needs 1,429 cohorts and $10 million in bonds; one exposed fake burns $700 of strangers' money. What operator finds seven strangers willing to share that risk?
